title: Quantifying resource dissipation applied to Li-ion battery recycling: Integrating Statistical Entropy Analysis and Exergy Cost Theory Insights into LCA
description: Data and code accompanying the research article “Quantifying resource dissipation applied to Li-ion battery recycling: Integrating Statistical Entropy Analysis and Exergy Cost Theory Insights into LCA”. The repository contains: (i) the Statistical Entropy Analysis (SEA) of a simulated hydrometallurgical Li-ion battery recycling flowsheet (12 unit processes, U1–U12), including robustness checks; (ii) the Exergy Cost Analysis (ECA) thermoeconomic models (traditional and residue approaches) and their results; (iii) the Brightway LCA implementation of the case study with exergy-based resource indicators (Cumulative Exergy Demand, CExD, and Cumulative Exergy Dissipation, CExD+) under three system-boundary transcriptions, based on ecoinvent 3.12 (not redistributed, licence restrictions); and (iv) the contribution analysis data exported from the Activity Browser (beta) “Tiers” panel used for the path contribution analyses of Figures 4, 5, 6 and Supplementary Material 4. In the notebooks, the code used to generate a manuscript figure is placed in a section preceded by the 📰 emoji.
